_comment: Synthetic GAL appointment case — appointment_level=expanded path. Court is appointing a GAL with the maximum scope: subpoena power, multi-record review, third-party engagement, mediation appearance. This complements case.example.json (limited path).

case_dict.case_title: In re Guardianship of M.K.B. and J.E.B. (Minors)

narrative_facts.context: Two-minor guardianship matter pending alongside a related district-court family proceeding. Maternal grandparents (petitioners) and father (objector) both seek custody. Allegations of substance abuse and educational neglect on both sides require a broad-scope GAL investigation: school records review across two districts, an evaluation by a licensed psychologist, family-counselor engagement, and the GAL is expected to appear at mediation. Court is granting subpoena power.
narrative_facts.good_cause_findings: Disputed allegations of substance abuse and educational neglect on both sides; concurrent family-court proceeding; two minors in different schools. Court finds that an expanded-scope GAL with subpoena power and authority to engage evaluators is necessary under 18-C § 1-115 to assess the children's best interests.
narrative_facts.objecting_parties_appointment: Father (Christopher Brennan) objects to the appointment of D. Whitten specifically due to a prior matter; objection overruled at the appointment hearing on 2026-05-09.
narrative_facts.appointment_factors: Court finds that D. Whitten has no actual conflict; the prior matter (closed 2021) does not bear on the current case.
narrative_facts.objecting_parties_fee: Father objects to bearing 50% of the fee; objection overruled — court allocates 75% petitioner / 25% father based on assets and income.
narrative_facts.fee_factors: Cap of 60 hours reflects expanded scope (subpoena work, two record-review subjects, evaluator engagement, mediation appearance).

expanded_scope.duties: Interview both minors separately, both petitioners, the father, and the minors' current teachers. Review school records from Portland Public Schools (Maya) and Cape Elizabeth Public Schools (Jacob) for the past 3 academic years. Review the father's substance-abuse treatment records from Day One Recovery (with consent or subpoena). Engage a licensed psychologist to evaluate both minors' attachment to each potential caretaker. Arrange family counseling for the children if necessary. File a written report 60 days before the contested hearing.
expanded_scope.interview_details: Interview Maya's 5th-grade teacher (Ms. Linda Park, Portland Reiche Elementary) and Jacob's 2nd-grade teacher (Mr. Roberto Diaz, Cape Elizabeth Pond Cove Elementary).
expanded_scope.review_records_1: Portland Public Schools records for Maya K. Brennan, AY 2023-2026.
expanded_scope.review_records_2: Cape Elizabeth Public Schools records for Jacob E. Brennan, AY 2023-2026.
expanded_scope.review_records_3: Day One Recovery treatment records for Christopher Brennan, 2024-present.
expanded_scope.evaluation_subject: Both minors' attachment to each potential caretaker; current developmental and emotional functioning.
expanded_scope.counseling_children: Both minors — bi-weekly sessions through report-filing date.
expanded_scope.contact_person: Dr. Sarah Lin (psychologist) — initial intake by 2026-05-30.
expanded_scope.other_duties: Coordinate with the district-court FM matter's GAL (if appointed) to avoid duplicate interviews of the children.

_what_this_exercises_beyond_limited: appointment_level=expanded writes 26+ expanded_* fields (vs 3 limited_* fields)
Multi-record review across THREE subjects (expanded_person_1..3 + record_types_1..3)
Active objection at appointment (objection_status=objecting → objecting_parties_appointment + appointment_factors filled)
Dual docket — probate AND district court (both populated, demonstrating cross-court coordination)
Fee objection AND fee resolution (objection_to_fee_status=objecting + objecting_parties_fee + fee_factors)
limited_* and standard_* fields stay null (writability gate excludes them)
